import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_3/test_0.csv"

# Load source data with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# The target schema is ['Major_category': string, 'Median': float]
# Source0 has these columns, so we can directly aggregate Median by Major_category.

# Since the target examples show Median as an average per Major_category,
# we group by Major_category and compute the average Median.

# Note: Median column may have nulls, pandas mean() ignores nulls by default.

result = df0.groupby('Major_category', as_index=False)['Median'].mean()

# Ensure the Median column is float type
result['Median'] = result['Median'].astype(float)

# Sort by Major_category to have a consistent order (optional)
result = result.sort_values('Major_category').reset_index(drop=True)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_3/target_multisource_cot.csv"
result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
